subject: note:propria_document_import_plan_20260912
title: Propria-wide documentation import, note creation and freshness plan
summary: Owner scope: Docstore serves all Propria projects and agents; Probata is its host, not its boundary. Delivery plan: (1) Inventory registered and omitted source roots, project notes, docs, contracts, decisions, handoffs, shared resources, agent instructions and historical worktree copies. Use explicit eligible files; record project, repository, source path, file type, size, raw hash and declared authority. Register non-Markdown formats only with an implemented extractor; report unsupported files. Exclude credentials, dependency/build caches, generated indexes, evidence/corpus bytes and quarantine. Preserve source files. (2) Query existing logical identity, source aliases and exact content hash before writes. Exact copies keep every source locator/provenance; conflicting or differently authoritative text is flagged for reconciliation, never silently merged. Historical worktree copies cannot overwrite current contracts. (3) Create governed notes with stable identities, actor, source reference, project/domain, priority and separate authority/status; append revision history with expected generation. Read every write back. Persist notes separately from their semantic-index freshness; approval is revision-specific. (4) Admit one pinned, complete multi-root manifest through the existing CocoIndex worker with a shared exclusive lock, bounded batches/providers, durable run ID, retry/cancel and append-only per-document outcomes. Do not treat a subset as the entire source inventory or retire omitted documents. Verify on isolated fixtures before production import. (5) Import order: owner decisions and shared contracts; project architecture and current plans; active handoffs/TODOs/reviews; historical material explicitly marked historical/superseded. Resolve graph links and source aliases with project provenance. (6) For every batch compare eligible manifest to stored logical records, source/projection fingerprints, chunk membership/counts/hashes, embedding model/version/dimensions, graph links and correlated CDC receipts. Exercise semantic retrieval plus full readback and graph queries. Report fresh, stale, missing, failed, unsupported and unverified independently; timestamps and process success are insufficient. (7) Publish per-project coverage and per-document freshness resources with checked-at time, source-change time, last-successful-run, pending changes, error and run/receipt references. Trigger bounded freshness checks before reliance on current contracts, after writes/imports and at handoff; indexing remains explicit. (8) Verify every supported agent host against the same canonical tools/resources: existence lookup, note create/readback, semantic search, retrieval, graph, API schemas and freshness checks. Keep CCC code indexing/search and Intake corpus tooling independently named and isolated. Acceptance: every eligible inventoried source is accounted for, no unexplained identity collision or omission, and each required host passes the real workflow. Current baseline: six registered roots, only Probata declared current ingestion; others pending. Live check 2026-09-13 03:24 UTC found docs/INDEX.md and docs/NAMING.md fingerprint mismatches, 10/16 observed chunks, zero observed broken links/dimension errors, and unproven CDC for both. INDEX lifecycle is unverified; NAMING active. Plan is not an executed import or a completion claim.
source_ref: Owner request 2026-09-12: index freshness checks, note creation, and import plan for all Propria project notes, docs and contracts; registry docs/docstore-source-registry.json
rationale: Implements the already recorded universal Docstore scope in an executable acceptance plan. Existing related universal decision reviewed; exact plan-key existence query returned no matches across four queried tables. Implementation details remain a proposal; no approval inferred.
